Anything outside of the Bible that you try to live your life by is a weariness of the flesh. All you will profit from it is getting tired. You might get a good night's sleep, unless a demon flies out of the bag reading some book with some kind of skin on it. There is no end to these books: they are always writing some book about what God is going to do on this earth, about his plans and who his people are. No other book can answer that except the Bible. When books are brought in class, they are filtered through the Bible. If they contradict the Bible, if they go against the laws, the commandments and the prophecies, they are garbage. They are brought only to illuminate the reading, as in Nehemiah 8:8.

The man spoken of is the Israelite man, because we are the ones who will make everybody else dance to the tune of this Bible, but it has to be done by us first. We are in training. That is why we are on this slave ship called America: because we broke God's laws and his commandments, and we must endure all of it to get back home.
